sql:
SELECT ts_doy, ts_hour, wtmp_c, ROUND(wtmp_c * 9/5 + 32, 1) as wtmp_f
FROM pier 
WHERE ts_doy BETWEEN 145 AND 152
ORDER BY ts_t DESC
LIMIT 24;

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, ROUND(AVG(yt) / AVG(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler, COUNT(*) as trips
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 140 AND 152 AND fish_date_season = 2
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls;

sql:
SELECT fish_date_doy, 
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / SUM(CASE WHEN anglers > 0 THEN anglers ELSE 1 END), 3) as yt_per_angler,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt, COUNT(*) as trips
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy >= 287 AND fish_date_doy <= 305 AND fish_date_season = 1
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC;
